claims.description: Query two Overpass HTTPS endpoints using the injected wx request adapter, with bounded attempts, timeout, cancellation, cached fallback and explicit recovery.
Read companion-host GPS coordinates and moving course through an injected watchPosition adapter; clear watches and ignore stale or revoked delivery.
Use optional host Accelerometer and Magnetometer factories for approximate compass heading; expire readings and fall back to GPS or manual direction.
Persist selected language, settings and up to three downloaded mountain areas through injected wx local-storage methods; surface denied storage and corrupt cache.
